Block size 4: the fastest of the drafter's default and 2-5 in smoke tests on this Mac (2 runs each, 4K prompt; T = 0.6 / greedy tok/s: default (adaptive, configured block 2) 74.5 / 82.4, block 2 66.2 / 67.1, 3 77.4 / 83.5, 4 80.4 / 87.5, 5 77.5 / 79.4).
